scope: Read-only alternative review, pinned vendor c25283e; no driver patch
proposal: Disable HostTxS only for reserved ra2 long beacon descriptors, retain buffers and rely on DMA ownership. This is distinct from MCU ACK.

source_references.fact: Long beacon descriptor uses MAC_TX_INFO, bss_idx/TxSPriv=apidx and Q_IDX_BCN
TYPE1 PID allocation precedes enabling tx_status_2_host from packet-type policy
Beacon host status policy applies to all WLAN indices
Beacon DMA done advances only to BCN_TX_DMA_DONE
Beacon TxS handler normally advances state to IDLE
Non-IDLE beacon enters recovery/refuses normal update

findings: Clearing HostTxS after allocation strands its reservation; a scoped design would have to skip allocation first.
Short-template HostTxS0 is a different path and does not prove long-beacon lifecycle compatibility.
Replacing DMA_DONE with IDLE changes pacing and requires separate host-buffer and RF/BSS states.
Permanent storage removes one lifetime hazard but not prior requested reports, queued RF transmissions or reset/remove obligations.
missing_evidence: Proven initial epoch without previously requested ra2 TxS
Exact long-descriptor HostTxS behavior for E1/E2
decision: No demonstrated safe host-only fix; do not modify production or mark TxS blocker fixed. Continue hardware queue/flush contract investigation.
